samples.question: Each panel has one unbranched black route from a green START disk to a colored terminal. Follow each route and read its six cyan and yellow checkpoints in travel order. Which terminal has the longest contiguous run in which checkpoint colors alternate cyan, yellow, cyan, yellow (or yellow, cyan, yellow, cyan)? A run stops when two consecutive checkpoints have the same color. Answer red, blue, or orange.
